summary: Norway localization of Business Central 29. It covers Norwegian VAT codes and proportional VAT, SAF-T export, electronic VAT returns, remittance and OCR/KID banking, EHF and PEPPOL e-invoicing, recurring sales orders and payroll import. Use it for questions about local fields, setup and reports.
overview:
The Norwegian layer adds VAT handling on top of W1: a single VAT code or number on journals and documents, VAT Reporting Code fields, proportional deduction of VAT in posting (codeunit 12 "Gen. Jnl.-Post Line", report 12 "VAT Statement", report 20), and SAF-T export (versions 1.20 and 1.30) with mapping of G/L accounts and VAT setup. Electronic VAT return submission uses ID-Porten and OAuth 2.0 objects. Learn documents these on pages such as "Norwegian VAT Codes", "Norwegian VAT Reporting" and "Set Up and Export Norwegian SAF-T Files".

Banking centers on a remittance module (objects in the 15000000 range): remittance accounts and agreements, payment suggestions, export to bank in SEPA, Telepay or BBS formats, import of receipt and settlement returns, error handling, plus OCR payment import and KID numbers. Vendor, vendor ledger, purchase and journal tables carry many added remittance and KID fields. SEPA and regulatory reporting code objects extend the bank area.

Sales and service add GLN, Account Code and E-Invoice fields on documents, reminders and finance charge memos. These feed legacy EHF export codeunits and the PEPPOL 3.0 Norway objects. Learn also notes the EHF workflow is being superseded by the E-Documents framework. Other features are recurring sales orders from blanket orders, and payroll import from Huldt & Lillevik Lønn - Visma.
key_points: VAT: VAT Code and VAT Number fields on journals, documents and VAT Posting Setup, with VAT Reporting Code extensions for reports and SAF-T.
Proportional VAT: Calc. Prop. Deduction VAT and Proportional Deduction VAT % on VAT Posting Setup, handled by new procedures in Gen. Jnl.-Post Line.
SAF-T: mapping setup, export, data check and wizard objects, with versions 1.20 and 1.30 selectable.
Electronic VAT return submission with ID-Porten authentication and OAuth 2.0 setup.
Remittance payments: accounts, agreements, suggestions, export to bank, return files, error pages and the waiting journal.
OCR and KID: OCR Setup, OCR payment import (BBS, Data Dialog), KID setup on Sales & Receivables Setup.
E-invoicing: legacy EHF export for invoices, credit memos, reminders and finance charge memos, plus PEPPOL 3.0 NO codeunits and xmlports.
Recurring sales orders via Recurring Groups and a Create Recurring Orders report; payroll import into general journals.

areas.what: Adds Norwegian VAT code and number fields to Gen. Journal Line, Posted Gen. Journal Line, VAT Posting Setup, VAT Entry and VAT Reporting Code. Gen. Jnl.-Post Line gets proportional deduction procedures, and VAT Statement gets non-deductible VAT procedures. Own objects cover SAF-T export and mapping, electronic VAT return submission, VAT periods, VAT specifications and notes.
areas.why: Learn describes Norwegian VAT codes, proportional VAT, SAF-T files and electronic VAT submission through ID-Porten as local requirements.

areas.what: Adds remittance, KID and recipient reference fields to Vendor, Vendor Templ., Vendor Ledger Entry and Purchase Header. Provides the remittance module: accounts, agreements, payment orders, waiting journal, return files, suggestion, test, export and import reports.
areas.why: Learn documents remittance accounts, agreements, suggestions, export and return file handling for electronic vendor payments in Norway.

areas.what: Adds GLN, Account Code and E-Invoice fields to sales and reminder documents, and KID and EHF path settings to Sales & Receivables Setup. Extends PEPPOL Management and Validation for reminders and finance charge memos. Adds recurring groups and recurring order creation.
areas.why: Learn covers KID numbers, EHF customer setup, giro printing and recurring sales orders.

areas.what: Adds Norwegian table and page extensions on service headers, lines, archives, invoices and credit memos, plus Norwegian service shipment, invoice and credit memo reports and helper codeunits.

Contains the legacy EHF electronic invoicing: check and export codeunits for sales and service invoices, credit memos, reminders and finance charge memos, export tables, and create-electronic-document reports. Also holds the OCR setup and OCR payment import and test reports.
areas.why: Learn describes EHF document creation, EHF file locations and OCR payment setup and import, and says the EHF workflow is being superseded by the E-Documents framework.

areas.what: Extends SEPA credit transfer export with waiting journal and payment order procedures and two events. Adds fields to Payment Export Data and Bank Export/Import Setup. Own objects import Pain.002 and CAMT.054 files and define regulatory reporting codes.
Adds PEPPOL 3.0 Norway objects: management, subscribers, install, payment codeunits, export codeunits for sales and service documents, invoice and credit memo xmlports, and a format enum extension.
areas.why: Learn notes PEPPOL BIS Billing 3.0 requirements for Norwegian electronic invoicing.

areas.what: Adds Enterpriseregister and related fields and a classification procedure on Company Information. Document-Print gets sales order printing procedures. Company-Initialize provides Norwegian SEPA CT code and name. SAF-T extensions are added to source codes and company contact.
Adds the Application always Allowed field to User Setup, and OAuth 2.0 setup extensions for electronic VAT. The LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets are changed.
areas.why: Learn describes using Application always Allowed in General Ledger Setup and User Setup to apply entries in closed VAT periods.

areas.what: Provides payroll integration for importing payroll transactions into general journals, with extensions on the general journal, its setup and import dimension codes.
areas.why: Learn describes import from Huldt & Lillevik Lønn - Visma through the Payroll Data Import Definition (NO) extension.

areas.what: Adds a document helper codeunit and a SAF-T data classification procedure in the Data Class. Eval. Data Country codeunit.

issues: The overview says service documents get the GLN, Account Code and E-Invoice fields. The input lists the service table extensions and the EHF service codeunits and reports, but it does not list their fields, so this is an inference. It is a reasonable one.

Some documented features are not mentioned: applying entries in closed VAT periods (the Application always Allowed field on General Ledger Setup and User Setup), the VAT Reconciliation report and the OCR-B giro printing setup. Also, the payroll import needs the Payroll Data Import Definition (NO) extension, which Learn mentions and the text does not. None of these gaps makes the text wrong.
